cast_dialogue.linea: The future is an unwritten map, heroes. 'Going to' is the pen: your plans and your predictions.
This weekend I'm going to visit my parents. And next year, I'm going to learn Japanese!
Really? Then I'm going to teach you! This Saturday I'm going to have a party.
Look at those clouds — it's going to rain. I'm going to stay home and watch a movie.
I'm going to bake a cake for the party. And next month, we are all going to travel together!

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Use 'be + going to + verb' for future plans (decided before speaking) and predictions with evidence ('Look at the clouds — it's going to rain'). Don't forget the verb 'to be'!

filas: I'm not going to go out.

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'Going to' needs the verb 'to be': 'I am going to...'

guion: Sofía: What are you going to do this weekend, Ben?
Ben: I'm going to visit my parents. And you?
Sofía: I'm going to stay home. Look at those clouds — it's going to rain!
Ben: Oh no. Are you going to Kenji's party on Saturday?
Sofía: Of course! We are all going to be there.
Ben: Great! I'm going to bring Abuela Carmen's cake.
